observation.command:
cat > /workspace/.devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml <<'EOF'
# Dev environment overlay: same service network as the documented devcontainer
# (dev-compose.yml + backend assets docker-compose.yml), but without the
# devcontainer VS Code service. Frontend/backend run on the host and are
# reached from caddy via host.docker.internal.
name: "startuphafen-devcontainer"

services:
  caddy:
    environment:
      BACKEND_HOST: 'host.docker.internal:5000'
      FRONTEND_HOST: 'host.docker.internal:4201'
      TZ: 'Europe/Berlin'
    ports:
      - '4000:8080'
    extra_hosts:
      - 'host.docker.internal:host-gateway'
    volumes:
      # path relative to this file
      - ../apps/startuphafen-backend/src/assets/caddy:/etc/caddy:ro

  database:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg15
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: app
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: app
      POSTGRES_DB: app
      TZ: 'Europe/Berlin'
    command: postgres -c timezone=Europe/Berlin -c log_timezone=Europe/Berlin
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U app']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    volumes:
      - dbdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data

  keycloak-database:
    image: postgres:15.5-bookworm
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: kc
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: kc
      POSTGRES_DB: kc
      TZ: 'Europe/Berlin'
    command: postgres -c timezone=Europe/Berlin -c log_timezone=Europe/Berlin
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U kc']
      start_interval: 1s
      start_period: 30s
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 2s
      retries: 5
    volumes:
      - kcdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data

  keycloak:
    ports:
      - 28080:8180
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.1.2
    environment:
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME: admin
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      KC_HOSTNAME_STRICT: 'false'
      KC_HTTP_ENABLED: 'true'
      KC_PROXY_HEADERS: xforwarded
      KC_DB: postgres
      KC_DB_URL: jdbc:postgresql://keycloak-database/kc
      KC_DB_USERNAME: kc
      KC_DB_PASSWORD: kc
      KC_HOSTNAME: http://localhost:4000/kc
      KC_HOSTNAME_ADMIN: http://localhost:4000/kc-admin
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8180
      KC_HEALTH_ENABLED: 'true'
      KC_METRICS_ENABLED: 'true'
      TZ: 'Europe/Berlin'
    entrypoint: ['/bin/bash', '/entrypoint.sh']
    depends_on:
      keycloak-database:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          'CMD-SHELL',
          "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/9000 && echo -e 'GET /health HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n' >&3 && cat <&3 | grep -q '200 OK'",
        ]
      start_interval: 1s
      start_period: 90s
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
    volumes:
      - ./keycloak/imports:/opt/keycloak/data/import
      - ./keycloak/entrypoint.sh:/entrypoint.sh:ro
      - ./keycloak/themes:/opt/keycloak/themes

  maildev:
    image: maildev/maildev
    ports:
      - '1080:1080'
    healthcheck:
      test: 'wget -O - http://127.0.0.1:1080/healthz || exit 1'
      start_interval: 1s
      start_period: 30s

  pgadmin:
    image: dpage/pgadmin4:8.12.0
    environment:
      PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL: pgadmin@example.com
      PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD: secret
      PGADMIN_CONFIG_SERVER_MODE: 'False'
    ports:
      - '3838:80'
    volumes:
      - ./pgadmin/servers.json:/pgadmin4/servers.json:ro

volumes:
  dbdata:
  kcdata:
EOF
cd /workspace && docker compose -f .devcontainer/dev-fixed.yml config --quiet && echo "COMPOSE FILE VALID"
